name: Queen Beatrix International Airport (Reina Beatrix)

hours.v: ATS, customs, fuel 11:00-03:00 UTC (07:00-23:00 local); AD administration and handling Mon-Fri 11:00-20:30 UTC (07:00-16:30 local); VFR flights not allowed between sunset and sunrise
hours.quote: VFR Flights are not allowed between Sunset and Sunrise.

customs.v: customs and immigration 11:00-03:00 UTC (07:00-23:00 local); US CBP preclearance for general aviation 13:00-23:00 UTC (09:00-19:00 local), 13:00-21:00 UTC during US daylight saving time, request 48 hours ahead

slots.v: all commercial aircraft, including cargo, need prior clearance/slot times from Aruba Airport Authority N.V., at least 7 days ahead; aircraft missing the slot are diverted to the alternate; no cargo slots Sat-Sun 14:00-23:59 UTC
slots.quote: All commercial aircraft, including cargo aircraft, need prior clearance/slot-times from the Aruba Airport Authority N.V.

noise.v: older ICAO Annex 16 Chapter 2 jets departing runway 11 keep runway heading to 6 DME BEA or 2,500 ft before turning

handling.v: general aviation terminal JET-TNCA, run by Aruba Airport Authority N.V., open 07:00-23:00 local; marshallers mandatory

notes: Read: AIP Dutch Caribbean (DC-ANSP) AD 2 TNCA html, publication folder 2024-08-08 (page shows no date); checked AIP Dutch Caribbean AIRAC AMDT 02-2025 (effective 17 Apr 2025): its checklist shows AD 2 TNCA pages dated 08 AUG 2024 or 20 FEB 2025, none changed in AMDT 02-25. The 20 FEB 2025 (AMDT 01-25) version of the TNCA page could not be opened: https://dc-ansp.org/eAIS/eAIP/AIRAC%20AMDT%2001-25_2025_02_20/eAIP/AD%202%20TNCA%20-%20ARUBA%201-en-US.html (permission not given), nor the eAIS index https://dc-ansp.org/eAIS/ ; so some TNCA values may have changed in Feb 2025 or in later 2025-2026 amendments not found. Also read Aruba Airport Authority General Aviation page. The AIP sets no night curfew; hours are the published ATS/customs hours (not called a curfew). Noise quote is shortened from the AD 2.21 text. Slot rule is worded for commercial aircraft; whether it applies to private flights is not stated. Local = UTC-4, no DST. IATA not stated in sources read.
